race.comment: Very open race. BRENLYN'S LEGACY (8) returned an excellent figure two runs back when successful over 1100m at Bendigo. May have been flattened by that run as the latest effort at Seymour was feeble. Freshened and can bounce back with Cory Parish partnering - he has four wins from seven rides on the four-year-old. BEFORE THE WAR (12) made late ground under a crushing 63kgs to finish third in an impressive return over this distance at Corowa last time out. Short course specialist who drops a huge 8kgs today. Sure to give a good account. TEYLU (5) raced very wide and consequently dropped out at his latest appearance over this trip at Canberra. Nicely drawn to play a role in the finish with a bit more luck. NARCISSIST (13) has been freshened up since failing at Seymour 33 days ago. Boasts an excellent 1000m record and can bounce back to form. JUGIONG (14) struggled to quicken under a crushing weight first-up at Corowa. Up in grade but can improve sharply with 9kgs less.
